frontend.i-classification: Digit glyphs, rotation labels, frames, prediction and invariant formula will be native text and SVG.
frontend.ii-grasping: The two point clouds are separate transparent PNGs. Grippers, pose axes, transformation arrow, g label and formula will be independent SVG elements.
frontend.iii-molecule: Atom circles, bonds, atom and index labels, transformation arrow and scalar-invariance formula will be native SVG.
frontend.a-e-mechanisms: All boxes, filters, basis kernels, point-set nodes, messages, arrows, text, formulas and separators will be rebuilt in the frontend.
